example.title: Third Street Historic District, Gensmann Building, 225-227 Third Street
example.source: HABS WI-117-J (photos via Wikimedia Commons mirror of HABS WIS,37-WASA,2J-)

brief: Three-storey red-brick Italianate block of 1885, name 'J. GENSMANN' in the frieze under a bracketed sheet-metal cornice, with a dated central pediment and pedimented cast hoods over tall paired 1/1 windows. Two storefronts under a continuous projecting metal cornice; a clothing, boot and shoe store traded here from the 1880s until the late 1960s.
